related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

outcome.recorded_basis: The earlier live query reported nine verified records but returned eight observation summaries; its returned identities ended with the correction record and omitted the newest correction readback. The original command output was not separately persisted, so this is a retrospective record of the active session's observed result, not a reconstructed timestamp or independent source artifact.
outcome.interpretation: One observed omission indicates that bounded compaction could hide a newly recorded result even when it had verified the evidence. Recurrence and impact on other agents are not established.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Compact projections can omit the newest verified observation
pressure_hypothesis.basis: At campaign checkpoint chk_2c72c698f6d6ff5d, the projection reported nine verified observations but returned eight compact summaries and omitted the newest correction readback. The code at commit 3feefc871acd53df94ea70225a193f41c8c5f56c selected observations with a prefix slice. This is one observed case; recurrence is not established.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve the newest observation tail using ledger page offsets when compacting, and report how many verified summaries were omitted.
